data.title: Apple Basket Challenge!
data.description: Practice giving a requested number of apples from a bigger pile.

challenges.hint: Try tapping the apples one by one as you count them out.
challenges.narration: Let's work together to count out some delicious apples from the pile!

challenges.hint: Take your time and tap each apple slowly so you don't miss any.
challenges.narration: Here is a bigger pile of apples. Let's see how many we can count out.

challenges.hint: Count them in a straight line from left to right.
challenges.narration: Look at these apples in a row! Let's count them carefully.

challenges.hint: You can touch each apple as you count to keep track.
challenges.narration: This pile has even more apples! Can you help me count them?

challenges.hint: Go all the way around the circle and count each one.
challenges.narration: You are doing wonderful counting! Let's finish up with this circle of apples.
